name: Conditional Antimatroids Are Contained in Both-Sides Dismantlable Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Conditional Antimatroids belongs to Both-Sides Dismantlable Ample Classes.
proof: In a meet-closed orientation, decreasing cardinality peels the primal class. Closure intervals [rho(v),v] partition its down-closure and give an explicit corner order on the entire original complement.
comments: V9-R005 author proof inspected at the stated scope; no claim of independent spectral-proof certification or external priority.
